title: New link between the fractional p-Laplacian operators and a class of McKean-Vlasov flight type processes
summary: We prove the existence of a McKean--Vlasov stochastic process with jumps associated to the nonlinear parabolic equation $\partial_t u = Δ_p u + Δ_p^s u$ in $\mathbb{R}^N\times(0,\infty)$, where $Δ_p$ is the $p$-Laplacian and $Δ_p^s$ is the fractional $p$-Laplacian. Our approach is the following: first, after proving the existence of a solution for the PDE presented earlier, we rewrite it as a nonlinear Fokker-Planck-Kolmogorov equation whose measure-valued solution is guaranteed when $p\ge4$.
